entities.summary: Canada is a sovereign nation in North America, Americas. Its capital is Ottawa. Official languages include English, French. Government: Federal parliamentary constitutional monarchy (Commonwealth realm). Population: approximately 41.3 million. Area: 9,984,670 km². Comprehensive index for Canada covering First Peoples (Beringia migration, First Nations, Inuit, Métis), Norse Vinland ~1000 CE, Cabot/Cartier/Champlain, New France, fur trade (Hudson's Bay Company), Seven Years' War/Plains of Abraham 1759, British North America, Confederation 1867, Riel Rebellions, residential schools (cultural genocide), both World Wars (Vimy Ridge), Quebec separatism, multiculturalism, Charter of Rights 1982, and Truth & Reconciliation.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Canada's history of colonialism and residential schools has had a profound impact on Indigenous peoples, with an estimated 150,000 to 200,000 people dying in residential schools between 1870 and 1996. The country's multiculturalism and Charter of Rights have also shaped its identity.
